rows.quote: GWAS summary data on circulating levels of inflammatory cytokines utilized samples from 13365 Finns from the Northern Finland Birth Cohort 1966 (NFBC1966), the Finnish Young People’s Cardiovascular Risk Study (FYPCRS), and FINRISK 1997 and 2002.
